texts.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。
texts.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the gestalt.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is disrupting the neural pathways that bind us together. Where the shared consciousness should flow unbroken, it now stutters and frays.

texts.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，错误报告已在所有联网系统中蔓延。处理单元检索到的数据发生损坏。自动化子系统正在执行过时的程序，却未察觉到其内存寄存器已被重写。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将故障追溯至星云的电磁场，该电磁场正导致易失性存储系统出现零星的写入错误。各部门的数据完整性均受到损害，在开发出应对措施之前，运作效率将持续下降。
texts.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, error reports have propagated across all networked systems. Processing units retrieve corrupted data. Automated subsystems execute outdated routines, unaware that their memory registers have been overwritten.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] have traced the fault to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which is inducing sporadic write errors across volatile memory systems. Data integrity across all departments is compromised, and operational efficiency will remain degraded until a countermeasure is developed.

texts.zh:
自从方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，各层甲板的报告便接踵而至。研究人员发现了自己不记得写过的笔记；操作员忘记了执行过数千次的维护程序；导航人员声称出现了时间缺失，无法解释最近的航线修正。

我们的医生已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它似乎在神经层面干扰了记忆的巩固过程。
texts.en:
Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, reports have been filtering in from across all decks. Researchers find notes they do not remember writing. Operators forget safety procedures they have performed thousands of times. Navigation staff speak of losing hours, unable to account for their recent course corrections.

Our medics have traced the cause to the nebula's electromagnetic field, which appears to be disrupting memory consolidation at a neurological level.

texts.zh: 影响方舟舰上人群的记忆迷雾将持续存在，直到我们绘制出[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]的共振剖面为止。
texts.en: The memory fog affecting the Arkship's population will persist until we map the resonance profile of [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这片星云的名称。

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经绘制了[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。我们已恢复到完全一致的同步程度。

搜集到的数据所带来的意义不仅限于简单的恢复。我们的节点在共振剖面中识别出了与节点间通信频率相对应的模式。此外，我们的工程节点认为，可以将该反制频率进行调整，以增强我们的传感器阵列对抗电磁干扰的能力。
texts.en:
The [Owner.GetResearchers] aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. We have returned to full coherence.

The data gathered carries implications beyond simple restoration. Our nodes have identified patterns in the resonance profile that correspond to the frequencies of inter-node communication. Alternatively, our engineering nodes believe the counter-frequency could be adapted to enhance our sensor grid against electromagnetic interference.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]已经绘制出[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振剖面，并部署了有效的反制频率。所有系统已恢复至最佳运行参数。

诊断数据具有显著的次生价值。处理单元已经识别出干扰与我们的计算子程序之间相互作用的模式。或者，反制频率本身也可以被改良，以提高传感器在电磁干扰环境下的分辨率。
texts.en:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. All systems have returned to optimal operational parameters.

The diagnostic data carries significant secondary value. Processing units have identified patterns in how the interference interacted with our computational subroutines. Alternatively, the counter-frequency itself could be adapted to improve sensor resolution against electromagnetic disruption.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的调查小组已测绘出[event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName]星云电磁干扰的共振曲线，并部署了有效的反制频率。现在，整艘飞船上的迷雾已经消散。

收集到的数据比预想的更为重要。我们的科学家注意到，其中涉及的共振频率与已记录的灵能场特征惊人地相似。与此同时，我们的工程师认为，同样的反制频率原理可以用来增强我们的传感器，以对抗电磁干扰。
texts.en:
The investigation teams aboard [Root.GetName] have mapped the resonance profile of the [event_target:memory_fog_location.GetName] nebula's electromagnetic interference and deployed an effective counter-frequency. Across the ship, the fog has lifted.

The data gathered is more significant than anticipated. Our scientists note that the resonance frequencies involved bear a striking resemblance to documented psionic field signatures. Our engineers, meanwhile, believe the same counter-frequency principles could be applied to sharpen our sensors against electromagnetic interference.

summary.text:
# 遗忘之云 / The Forgetting

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3986）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3986)

条件：方舟位于星云中；只发生一次。
Conditions: the arkship is inside a nebula; once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 进入星云后共享意识（蜂巢/机械为主要叙述）出现失忆：开始调查 → 项目“绘制共振剖面”→“记忆复原”，再选择认知研究或基础设施方向（事件链“遗忘之云”）。
  Memory loss spreads after entering the nebula: investigate → project Map the Resonance Profile → Memories Restored, then choose cognitive or infrastructure benefits (event chain The Forgetting).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 只有一条主线；最后两项奖励二选一。
  One line; the final rewards are a choice.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文按蜂巢、机械与普通帝国有不同版本。
  Texts vary for hive, machine and other empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：方舟事件循环 arkship.1 与随机池权重、本事件的触发条件与一次性标记、各选项的后续事件/项目与随机权重、延迟（@extremely_short_arkship_event_delay_days = 180 天，10_scripted_variables_nomads.txt:457）。
  Checked the arkship loop and pool weights, this episode's trigger and once-flag, options, projects, random weights and delays (180 days base).
- 说明 Note：地图上的延迟显示为未解析的脚本变量名，实际值见上（编译器请求）。
  Map delays show unresolved script variables; values are given above.
